```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Virtual Lab Management System Test Suite

**Target Application:** Virtual Lab Management System

**Target Platform:** Heroku with Ver. 5.7.21 MySQL Database

**Target Users:** Lab Incharge, Chemist, Admin, Patient

**Test Cases:**

**Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID(s) | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
TC-001 | Lab Incharge can perform lab tests and update reports | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Lab test details, report data | Perform lab test, update report | Report is updated successfully
TC-002 | Lab Incharge can set the flag in prescription | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Prescription with flag to set | Set flag in prescription | Flag is set successfully
TC-003 | Chemist can deliver medicine to the patient | VIRTUA-2.3-14 | Positive | Chemist is logged in | Patient information, medicine details | Deliver medicine to patient | Medicine is delivered successfully
TC-004 | Admin and Patient can view invoice and reports | UC-14 | Positive | Admin and Patient are logged in | Appointment details | View invoice and reports | Invoice and reports are displayed correctly
TC-005 | System is deployed on Heroku platform | VIRTUA-2.4-1 | Constraint | N/A | N/A | N/A | System is deployed on Heroku platform with Ver. 5.7.21 MySQL Database
TC-006 | System is accessed via Hospital website | VIRTUA-2.4-2 | Interface | N/A | N/A | N/A | System is accessible via Hospital website
TC-007 | System supports multiple browsers | VIRTUA-2.4-2 | Interface | N/A | N/A | N/A | System supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and other browsers
TC-008 | System supports multiple operating systems | VIRTUA-2.4-3 | Constraint | N/A | N/A | N/A | System supports MS Windows, Unix, Linux, and Apple Mac
TC-009 | System can print and store invoices and prescriptions | VIRTUA-2.4-4 | Functional | N/A | N/A | N/A | Invoices and prescriptions can be printed and stored

```
